top_reply.author: @dotracmania1901
top_reply.text: You don't need a Claude skill. Just have a vision in mind of what you want to do, how you want it to appear, what you want to communicate, then begin from there. It is better you learn the process yourself than outsourcing it to a skill you can't tell the accuracy of, or whether it takes into account scenarios and nuances that apply in your specific case
